version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent Google Search Console integration, but it asks users to install and allowlist an unpinned external plugin that then relies on a live tool catalog for sensitive account operations.

dimensions.detail: External OAuth handling and Search Console access are expected for this integration, and write operations are documented as requiring confirmation, but the plugin receives broad allowlisted integration authority after install.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup installs `clawhub:clawlink-plugin`, adds it to `tools.alsoAllow`, and restarts the gateway without pinning an immutable version, checksum, signature, or included reviewed plugin source.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to treat the live ClawLink Google Search Console tool catalog and returned tool guidance as the source of truth, which means schemas and behavior can change outside the reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The install changes OpenClaw configuration and activates a persistent plugin across chats; the artifact does not document rollback, version control, or containment for the allowlisted plugin.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the capabilities: it connects OpenClaw to Google Search Console through ClawLink for analytics, URL inspection, sitemap management, and verified-site management.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the ClawLink plugin before installing, confirm you trust ClawLink to hold and use Google Search Console OAuth access, and only proceed if you are comfortable with a persistent allowlisted plugin whose live tool catalog may change. Be especially careful with site deletion, site addition, and sitemap submission actions, and require clear previews before approving writes.
llm.findings:
[T08] unexpected: The integration does need a plugin, but the artifact-backed install path is unpinned and allowlists third-party executable behavior that is not included in the reviewed skill package.
[T07] expected: Dynamic tool discovery is part of the ClawLink integration model, but relying on remote tool definitions as authoritative for sensitive Search Console operations creates review-relevant ambiguity.
